# verify_archives

[← Command index](README.md)

Test archive files for corruption with 7-Zip.

## Synopsis

```
verify_archives [options]
```

## Description

Finds every archive of the chosen types under the input path (or takes the one file
given) and runs `7z t` on it, which reads every entry and checks its CRC. The run
stops with an error at the first archive that fails.

Nothing is written or changed.

## Options

### General

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-i, --input_path <input_path>` | An archive file, or a directory searched recursively for archives; must exist. |
| `-a, --archive_types <archive_types>` | Archive types to test, space separated; each selects files by its extension. Default: `ZIP`. Allowed: `ZIP`, `INSTALL`, `7Z`, `RAR`, `TAR_BZ2`, `TB2`, `TBZ`, `TBZ2`, `TZ2`, `TAR_GZ`, `TAZ_GZ`, `TGZ`, `TAR_LZ`, `TAR_LZMA`, `TLZ`, `TAR_LZO`, `TAR_XZ`, `TXZ`, `TAR_Z`, `TZ`, `TAZ`, `TAR_ZST`, `TZST`, `ISO`, `EXE`, `APPIMAGE`. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Test every zip in a folder

```bash
verify_archives -i /path/to/archives
```

### Test zip and 7z archives

```bash
verify_archives -i /path/to/archives -a ZIP 7Z
```

## Notes

- Archives are matched by extension only, e.g. `ZIP` selects `.zip` files and `TAR_GZ` selects `.tar.gz` files.
- 7-Zip must be installed as a JoyBox tool.
